messages:
alex: Heads-up  I'm splitting the Usage tiers guide into two: metering vs pricing to cut down on user confusion. Opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/834. Need eyeballs on the SDK snippet and dashboard links.
maya: link?
alex: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/834
jordan: Quick scan: Python snippet still uses `client.create_metering` which is deprecated. Should be `client.report_usage`. Also, public grafana panel link references panel id 1100 but that panel moved to a different folder last week.
samir: I can update the code block in a mini-PR. Do we want to keep both legacy and current examples, or only show the modern API?
ciara: Keep both, but mark the legacy one clearly as deprecated. Customers with pinned SDKs will appreciate the migration notes.
li: For the migration checklist, we should include: replace `X-Usage-Tier` header samples, clarify burst window semantics, and change example payloads to include `token_total` rather than `token_count` where applicable. Add a small JSON schema snippet.
alex: Good. I'll add the checklist to the PR description and update the migration guide section.
maya: Also reword the sentence about throttling. Right now it says "requests may be throttled" which is too vague. Spell out that we return 429 with Retry-After and quota reasons.
jordan: I'll add a short example response and an exponential backoff client snippet:
```
# backoff example
for attempt in range(5):
    resp = client.request(...)
    if resp.status_code == 429:
        wait = int(resp.headers.get('Retry-After', '1')) * (2 ** attempt)
        time.sleep(wait)
    else:
        break
```
samir: Ops asked that public docs avoid embedding raw internal panel IDs. Replace panel IDs with `{{panel_link}}` tokens and link to friendly dashboard pages. I pinged infra for a stable redirect mapping.
alex: Will swap IDs for tokens and add a short explanation.
ciara: Tag @ops-infra in the PR for the redirect ticket.
maya: Can we add a docs-test for the snippet? We have the docs-tests runner that executes Python snippets against the mock server.
alex: Yes, adding a doctest that runs the snippet against the `docs-test` mock endpoint.
li: Also update i18n extraction: mark changed strings with `_()` so translators pick them up. The extractor previously captured old strings; we need a fresh extraction pass.
jordan: Noted. I'll add an i18n note in the PR and the tupdate to the changelog.
alex: PR updated with checklist, backoff snippet, tokenized panel links, and doctest. Local linting is green but CI queued?
maya: CI queued: https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/834. Linter failed on a trailing whitespace in a fenced code block.
samir: Fixed and pushed a tiny commit.
ciara: Staging preview looks good: /docs/staging/usage/tiers shows split pages, examples render, and deprecated banner is visible.
docs-bot: staging deploy successful 4aa https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/usage/tiers
alex: Verified. Sample payload schema renders, doctest passes.
maya: After merge, add a line to the release notes: "Usage docs split: metering + pricing pages; updated SDK examples; dashboard links tokenized; migration checklist added."
alex: Added to release notes in the PR.
ciara: Merged. :tada:
alex: Thanks everyone. I'll follow up with a short cross-link from Billing FAQ to the migration guide.
maya: Thanks Alex.
alex: Closing thread.
